comment: Gridded emissions produced after harmonization and downscaling as part of PolMIP-CMIP7. Long-term extension 2101-2500. 2100 gridded values aligned to fast-track (SO2-em-anthro_input4MIPs_emissions_PolMIP_IIASA-IAMC-SSP2-com-CMIP7-1-1-2_gn_202201-210012.nc) via per-cell, per-month additive offset with linear fade from year 2100 (full correction) to year 2150 (zero correction); anchor timestep 2100 dropped from output.
